# The Python reference implementation the parity harness is proven against.
# Pinned exactly, the same way testdata/gen/package.json pins
# @stellar/stellar-sdk for the JS side.
stellar-sdk==16.1.0

# xdrlib3 is the XDR packer/unpacker stellar-sdk uses to turn a preimage into
# the bytes this harness hashes. It is pinned too: a different runtime is a
# different byte producer, and byte parity is the whole point. The version is
# the one stellar-sdk==16.1.0 resolves today.
xdrlib3==0.1.1
